thought.text: The login form POSTs to `/users/sign-in` (dash) with a CSRF token from a meta tag. My earlier curl POSTed to the wrong path. Let me confirm the route and the csrf token meta tag, then do a proper authenticated login.

reasoning_content:
The login form POSTs to `$route.path` (i.e. `/users/sign-in`) and includes an `authenticity_token` obtained from a `<meta name="csrf-token">` tag. My earlier curl failed because I POSTed to `/users/sign_in` (underscore) and didn't obtain the token. Let me check the routing and the CSRF meta tag, then perform a proper login with the documented credentials.

Important: The route is `sign-in` (with a dash). I'll verify the route and the meta tag.

action.command: cd /workspace; grep -nE "sign-in|sign_in" config/routes.rb | head; echo "=== csrf meta in page ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in | grep -iE 'csrf|meta name="csrf-token"'; echo "=== devise routes ==="; grep -n "devise_for\|:devise\|sign-in" config/routes.rb
